metadata.description: Fifteen MIT GTM operator skill packs: PSP, EVP, cold email, founder-brand, pricing, landing page, GEO, sales offer, prospect list, email sequence, qualify-before-enrich, found-vs-deliverable, signal-with-a-link, waterfall-email, inbound-from-domain. Install all fifteen with the gtm plugin. Plus build-pack, the gate for the next pack.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: The whole suite in one install: all fifteen packs, plus /gtm:setup (shared questions once) and /gtm:next (which pack to run next).

plugins.name: gtm-operator
plugins.description: The GTM operator mod for Claude Code: scores every go-to-market draft with its own skill pack's scorer, flags stale and inconsistent drafts across packs, pack dashboards, a guided sprint, analytics, and a guard that keeps brand-config.json and SOUL.md merged.

plugins.name: psp
plugins.description: A Pain Signal Profile is a five-part buying brief. It replaces a static ICP.

plugins.name: evp
plugins.description: An Early Value Proposition is a ≤22-word line matched to a Schwartz awareness tier.

plugins.name: cold-email
plugins.description: Four jobs in under 90 words: signal, pain, EVP, binary ask. Demographics are not a signal.

plugins.name: founder-brand
plugins.description: Pillar / Proof / Process / Person. Refuses thought-leader cadence.

plugins.name: pricing
plugins.description: Pricing surgery: WTP, value metric, reference frame, three-tier contrast, pocket-price leaks.

plugins.name: landing-page
plugins.description: One page, one offer, one action. Drafts the page and scores it; refuses a sitemap.

plugins.name: geo
plugins.description: Generative engine optimization: score whether a page gets quoted by an answer engine. Refuses a content calendar.

plugins.name: sales-offer
plugins.description: What the buyer gets, what it costs, and why now. Refuses a pitch of the paid product.

plugins.name: prospect-list
plugins.description: Score who to contact this week from one public buying signal. Refuses a title-only list.

plugins.name: email-sequence
plugins.description: The series of emails after someone raises their hand. Refuses a generic drip.

plugins.name: qualify-before-enrich
plugins.description: ICP field check on every list row before any paid finder. Refuses paid lookup on a failing row.

plugins.name: found-vs-deliverable
plugins.description: A found email is not sendable until verify returns deliverable. Catch-all, unknown, and invalid stay in their buckets.

plugins.name: signal-with-a-link
plugins.description: A buying signal is a dated, linkable event. Refuses firmographic state and any intent score without a URL and a date.

plugins.name: waterfall-email
plugins.description: Cheapest-first email waterfall: held inputs first, stop on 4xx, refuse sendable until verify = deliverable.

plugins.name: inbound-from-domain
plugins.description: Enrich inbound from the email domain and route in seconds. Refuses CRM write-back in the free pack.

plugins.name: build-pack
plugins.description: The gate for the next GTM skill pack: knowledge card, design card, security, README, and plugin checks. For pack authors, not a customer pack.
